1. Initiate conversation with Vincent Vance.
2. Select topic 2.
3. Press ESC before audio line completes.
bugs.expected_behavior: Dialogue state resets to idle and movement controls unlock.
bugs.actual_behavior: Movement remains locked until clicking the conversation window again.

documents.title: Blue Note Audio Bus & Spatial Acoustics Guide
documents.content:
# Blue Note Lounge Acoustic Design

## Bus Routing
- Master / Music / Piano_Stem / Reverb_Hall.
- Master / Ambience / Rain_Glass / Crowd_Mutter.

## Dynamic Mix Rules
- Dialogue reduces piano high-pass frequencies by 6dB automatically.

decisions.title: ADR-002: Dynamic Music Layering via FMOD Studio Stems
decisions.context: The music must react dynamically to the player approaching tables or asking tense questions.
decisions.options_considered:
1. AudioSource crossfading in Unity audio engine.
2. FMOD Studio parameter-driven multi-track events.
decisions.chosen_approach: FMOD Studio parameter-driven event with 4 intensity layers.
decisions.reasoning: Zero click artifacts on transition and sample-accurate bar sync.

storyBibleEntries.title: Vincent Vance - The Weary Virtuoso
storyBibleEntries.summary: Resident jazz pianist at the Blue Note Lounge who knows too much about the disappearances in the district.
storyBibleEntries.body: Vincent has played the Steinway at the Blue Note for fifteen years. His fingers know the keys better than his own memories. His right hand carries a faint burn scar from the warehouse district fire. He speaks in measured sentences and watches every newcomer through the brass mirror mounted above the upright piano.

assets.name: Rain on the Neon Awning (Main Theme Motif)
assets.description: Smoky, melancholic muted trumpet with slow walking upright bass and subtle vinyl flutter.

assets.name: Vincent Vance Character Concept & Turnaround
assets.description: Full costume and facial turnaround for resident jazz pianist Vincent Vance, highlighting cigarette burn scar on knuckles.

### Blue Note Lounge — Project & Production Intelligence

**Blue Note Lounge** is Cindermarch Studio's atmospheric **noir mystery narrative game** set in an evocative retro jazz lounge.

#### 1. Narrative Premise & World-Building
- **Setting:** Late 1940s neon-lit jazz club filled with cigarette smoke, rain beating on neon awnings, and brass mirrors.
- **Lead Protagonist / NPC:** **Vincent Vance** (*The Weary Virtuoso*), resident Steinway pianist with a burn scar from the warehouse district fire.
- **Gameplay Loop:** Branching character dialogue trees and interactive piano key triggers uncovering district disappearances.

#### 2. Engine & Audio Architecture
- **Engine Version:** **Unity 6000.0.25f1**
- **Repository:** `BlueNote-Main@cindermarch`
- **Dynamic Audio:** FMOD Studio parameter-driven multi-track events ([ADR-002](/decisions?decisionId=ADR-002)) with 4 dynamic intensity stems.

#### 3. Project Health & Active Milestones
- **Project Health:** **BLOCKED** (60/100 score)
- **M1: Jazz Club Ambience & Character Dialogue Tree (Prototype)**: Target Date: **2026-11-30** [Status: **In Progress**]
